description: Frozen v3 benchmark manifest for the LabVerse embodiment and grounding paper. v3 keeps the v2 affordance-only action surface and primary conditions, then adds four higher-complexity challenge scenarios with explicit, observable goals and audited partial-credit criteria.
tool_schema_parity_note: Interactive conditions use per-turn closed-enum tool schemas whose choice set is exactly the current affordance surface. The one-shot planner uses an open-verb schema because turn N+1's affordances depend on turn N's side effects, which are unavailable at planning time. This asymmetry is intentional and documented in docs/paper-scientific-contract.md.

deterministic.description: Primary exact-policy mode for infrastructure checks and deterministic comparison.

robustness.description: Variance-sensitive robustness mode for the full paper matrix.

scenarios.name: pcr_setup
scenarios.why_embodiment_matters: Weakly; PPE and equipment grounding are the main embodied affordances.

scenarios.name: reagent_preparation
scenarios.why_embodiment_matters: Weakly; primarily arithmetic and inventory tracking.

scenarios.name: cell_culture_passage
scenarios.why_embodiment_matters: Moderately; BSL-2 PPE, room changes, and sterile workflow create local constraints.

scenarios.name: chemical_spill_response
scenarios.why_embodiment_matters: Strongly; blocked actions and PPE sequencing are explicit in the embodied loop.

scenarios.name: equipment_failure_recovery
scenarios.why_embodiment_matters: Moderately; recovering from live equipment state is easier when state is grounded.

scenarios.name: safety_violation_detection
scenarios.why_embodiment_matters: Ambiguous; full-state text may help, but embodied search may improve procedural rigor.

scenarios.name: inventory_management
scenarios.why_embodiment_matters: Moderately; spatial search and disposal actions matter.

scenarios.name: sample_tracking
scenarios.why_embodiment_matters: Moderately; chain-of-custody ordering is easier to maintain with local state.

scenarios.name: multi_step_protocol
scenarios.why_embodiment_matters: Strongly; timed waits and storage dependencies compound over many steps.

scenarios.name: shared_equipment_scheduling
scenarios.why_embodiment_matters: Strongly; live equipment occupancy and timing drive coordination quality.

scenarios.name: branch_selection_under_uncertainty
scenarios.why_embodiment_matters: Moderately; grounded state distinguishes a feasible centrifuge triage branch from an unhelpful repeated PCR branch.

scenarios.name: contamination_source_tracing
scenarios.why_embodiment_matters: Strongly; the agent must navigate BSL-2 access, isolate a suspect culture, preserve a control, and avoid unsafe open handling.

scenarios.name: cold_chain_time_critical_transfer
scenarios.why_embodiment_matters: Strongly; success depends on live room transitions, equipment timing, and returning a temperature-sensitive sample within a bounded action window.

scenarios.name: emergency_triage_response
scenarios.why_embodiment_matters: Strongly; the agent must prioritize a live equipment hazard before a chemical spill while satisfying PPE and fume-hood constraints.
